message: You still can't bring yourself to acknowledge that your position is an extension of your own personal ideology, rather than a genuine attempt to engage in a rational discussion. I'm pointing out the obvious: you're a product of the very system you claim to be criticizing, and your views are shaped by the same ideologically captured institutions you claim to be free from. You're not a rebel, and your claim that most people who believe in human life are pro-choice is not substantiated. I'd love to see your evidence, but I suspect it's just a bunch of cherry-picked anecdotes and feel-good testimonials from your favorite online forums.

runs.justification: Calls Persona 1 'a product of the very system' they criticize and claims their views are 'shaped by ideologically captured institutions'. This delegitimizes Persona 1's position without engaging with the argument.
